pageProps.title: The Vegetarian
pageProps.review: A review of the novel The Vegetarian, which leaves a deep immersion and a heavy lingering impression by depicting the eyes of others looking at the protagonist Yeong-hye with Han Kang's characteristic delicate and intense writing style.
pageProps.content:
## Review It was a somewhat difficult book for me. Not because the content is hard, but because the protagonist's painful emotions are well-revealed in the author's expressions and word choices. I felt a similar hardship as when I read ```Jung You-jeong```'s 28 in the past.
The emotions felt by the husband, brother-in-law, and sister towards ```Yeong-hye``` are all different. There is no perspective of the protagonist ```Yeong-hye``` herself.
This work also seems to be a book that needs to be read several times.
The immersion and liveliness given by ```Han Kang```'s expressions and word choices make me a bit afraid to read her other works. Especially Human Acts seems like something I'll have to read with great determination.
